subject: 45-year-old man with cork-textured lapels
art_direction: 45岁男性灰卷发配超宽木栓质感翻领，内搭完全覆盖，灰蓝背景与温暖皮肤相映。
composition: one original central subject with a clear silhouette and circular-crop safe focal point
creative_direction: Create an original 45-year-old man with loose gray curls, a long nose, and a thoughtful but approachable expression. He wears a fully covered dark turtleneck beneath a jacket with oversized cork-textured lapels, their edges folded into broad asymmetric curves. Blend photographic skin and fabric detail with painterly simplification at the hair and background. Use muted steel-blue surroundings and warm side light. Keep the lapels framing rather than swallowing the face, and show only the upper torso. Avoid literary props, famous-person resemblance, lettering, and decorative pins. Square 1024x1024. Keep the complete central silhouette within a circular crop, occupying about 70% of the canvas. Original design; no lettering, logos, or watermark.
style_inspiration: Entirely original text-only concept, no IP characters, copied artwork, celebrity likeness or named artist imitation.
visual_review: passed: compressed preview inspected for distinct original concept, appealing silhouette and expression, requested medium, coherent shape/anatomy, clean visual hierarchy, no text or watermark
